field_edits.updated_text: Multiple degenerative changes are noted in the wrist with multifocal reduction of joint spaces, marginal osteophyte formation and subchondral sclerosis. Degenerative changes are more pronounced at the 1st carpometacarpal joint with appreciable joint-space narrowing and osteophyte formation. Mild degenerative changes are also seen at the remaining visualized intercarpal and carpometacarpal articulations. No dislocation.

impression:
1. Multifocal osteoarthritic/degenerative changes of the wrist with multiple reduced joint spaces, more pronounced osteoarthritis at the 1st carpometacarpal joint.
2. No acute osseous abnormality.
